reason: My plans come out of my WhatsApp groups — someone says hike Saturday and we go. I might scroll this app after dinner like I scroll stories, but I am not going to buy a concert ticket through an app none of my people are on yet.
objection: Who is actually behind this feed? 'Complete and curated' is a promise, not a fact, and I trust the guy in my hiking group more than a new app's listings.
would_change_my_mind: If my hiking or language-exchange group started posting our meetups there and I saw faces I know going to events, I would join through it and eventually buy a ticket there too.
